design: W0 locator/range-only vs W1 + bounded current-source witness. All else frozen (static, memory off, recipes off, utility off). 24q x 2 arms x 2 reps = 96 serial devin -p sessions on memepilot + reposuite-repodex.
central_result: W1 delivered exact current source bytes but the Agent reread the same evidence at the SAME rate (83% both arms). Case C: the bottleneck is Agent verification behavior/trust, not missing source bytes.
w2_note: reread threshold was met (83%) but W2 (provenance text) would only test persuasion, not missing evidence — the agent verifies by policy, not by missing bytes
break_even: witnesses added ~1% input tokens but reads did not fall -> no break-even
